import numpy as np
n = 100
H = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=complex)
idx = np.arange(n - 1)
H[idx, idx + 1] = 0.85 * 1.35
H[idx + 1, idx] = 0.85 * 0.65
H[n - 1, 0] = 0.85 * 1.35
H[0, n - 1] = 0.85 * 0.65
site = np.arange(1, n + 1)
psi = np.exp(-((site - 50.5) ** 2) / 200.0) * np.exp(1j * (np.pi / 2) * site)
psi = psi / np.linalg.norm(psi)
dt = 3.3333333333333335
assert np.allclose(chebyshev_step(H, psi, dt, 1e-14, 5, 4000)[0], target)
